findings.message: The check compares a resolved `target` against an unresolved `UPLOAD_DIR`. If `UPLOAD_DIR` is relative or passes through a symlink, `is_relative_to` is always false and every legitimate upload is refused.

`read_upload` takes only a file name and has no notion of the requesting user. Any client can read any file in the shared upload directory, including other users' `{user_id}.png` avatars, so users are not limited to their own uploads.
